Moss goes on the screen-right of the amber post; Kestrel goes on its screen-left. In the first cue Kestrel gives a soft nod, in the second Moss waves clearly, and in the third Kestrel is neutral with soft variation. Keep both roots still.
Put Lyra screen-left of the white column and Tev screen-right. Cue one is a clear wave by Tev; cue two is a soft nod by Lyra; cue three is a soft neutral pose by Tev. Neither person walks.

Pavo stands to the audience-left of the floor star, and Sena to its audience-right. The first cue belongs to Pavo: wave clearly. The second belongs to Sena: neutral softly. The third belongs to Pavo: nod softly. Hold their positions.
From the audience view, Iona is on the brass ring's right and Calder on its left. In order: first Iona waves softly; second Calder nods clearly; third Calder is neutral softly. Keep both roots fixed.

Nell stands screen-left of the linen marker and Orsa screen-right. Plan the cues as Nell waving softly first, Orsa nodding clearly second, and Nell neutral softly third. Correction: make the first cue Orsa waving clearly. Final correction: instead, the first cue is Nell nodding softly. The second and third cues stay as in the original plan.

Place Suri on the granite cube's screen-left and Tomel on its screen-right. Tomel takes all three cues: a soft nod, then a clear wave, then a soft neutral pose. Suri takes no cue and remains stationary.

The stage is viewed from the audience. Vail belongs on the stage-left side of the beacon; Nori takes the other side. Stage-left here means the left side of the image. Vail waves softly in the opening cue, Nori nods clearly in the next cue, and Vail is neutral softly in the final cue. Keep roots still.

Read the east arch from the audience viewpoint: Bela is on the image-left side of it, while Ash is on the image-right side. Ash gives the first cue, a clear nod; Bela gives the second, a soft wave; Ash is neutral softly in the last cue. Keep both roots in place.
